## silly-xylophone

### Description and Rationale
We are a team of students with a strong interest in aviation, air traffic management, and data-driven analysis. We decided to register for the PRC Data Challenge to apply our analytical and technical skills to a real-world aviation problem and gain practical experience working with large-scale flight data. We are particularly interested in exploring the data, identifying meaningful patterns and operational insights, and developing a solution that can contribute to a better understanding of air traffic performance. The challenge also provides an excellent opportunity for us to learn, collaborate as a team, and work on a problem with real-world relevance to the aviation industry.

### Details

* Number of team members: 2
* Type: Academia
* Affiliation: International school of management
* Country: Germany
